verdict.rationale: Codegen provides a Python SDK and API to programmatically trigger agents (including explicitly 'from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail') and run tasks headlessly, which supports scripted/headless invocation. However, evidence does not show a lightweight headless CLI mode designed for shell-script piping (the CLI seems oriented toward interactive/telemetry use), nor examples of GitHub Actions/Jenkins integration snippets or exit-code/status handling for pipeline gating. missing for 10: concrete CI/CD pipeline config examples (e.g. GitHub Actions yaml), documented headless CLI flags/exit codes for scripting, and independent/hands-on confirmation of pipeline use.
